name: Forest's Edge
summary: Riverpaw gnolls under Hogger threaten travelers at Forest's Edge, along Elwynn's southwestern frontier.

sections.title: A Contested Frontier
sections.body: At Forest's Edge, woodland runs southwest from Stormwind City between Mirror Lake Orchard and the rivers that border Westfall. Westbrook Garrison lies nearby, but Stormwind's thin ranks leave the woods open to wild beasts and raiding parties. Boars roam among the trees and along the banks. Riverpaw gnolls gather here in force, using the woods as a staging ground.

sections.title: Hogger's Stronghold
sections.body: Hogger and his pack hunt through the woods of Forest's Edge. A massive, brutal gnoll chieftain, he leads raids on nearby farms and harasses travelers. The Stormwind Army has placed a bounty on his head. His pack makes the timberland dangerous for anyone who crosses it.

faq.answer: Forest's Edge lies in southwestern Elwynn Forest, south of Westbrook Garrison. Mirror Lake Orchard and the waterways leading toward Westfall border the area.

faq.q: Why is this area so dangerous?
faq.answer: Riverpaw gnolls have claimed the woods and threaten travel along Elwynn's southwestern border. Their chieftain, Hogger, is the fiercest threat, prowling the same woods.
Hogger is a powerful gnoll leader who directs violent attacks along Elwynn's borders. The Stormwind Army has offered a bounty for proof of his death and warns adventurers not to face him alone.

faq.q: Why hasn't Westbrook Garrison cleared the area?
faq.answer: Stormwind's military is stretched thin across the kingdom. Unrest in Westfall and threats on all sides leave Westbrook Garrison without enough soldiers to clear the gnoll camps, so volunteers are left to confront them.

angles.text: As an Alliance recruit in Elwynn Forest, clearing Forest's Edge and defeating Hogger is an early trial of your readiness to serve the crown.
Forest's Edge has common woodland herbs along its riverbanks and in its shaded groves. You may have to avoid aggressive gnoll patrols while gathering them.
